records.text: In April 2011 the Arizona Senate confirmed Tyler Bowyer as student regent for the Arizona Board of Regents for a two-year term beginning July 1.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: In April of 2011, at the end of his spring semester, he is elected by the Arizona Senate to serve as a student representative to the Arizona Board of Regents. It says that the state Senate has confirmed ASU undergraduate Tyler Storm Bowyer as the new student regent for the Arizona Board of Regents. It begins a two-year term beginning on July 1st.

verification.notes: Contemporaneous University of Arizona reporting confirms Bowyer's 2011 appointment as student regent and the two-year term beginning that July; later reporting records the term ending June 30, 2013.

sources.title: Governor appoints new student regent
sources.relevance: Contemporaneous report of Bowyer's appointment and two-year term beginning in July 2011.

records.text: Erika Frantzve enrolled at Arizona State University for her final year of college after Tyler Bowyer became student regent.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: in May of 2011, Tyler Bowyer is going to get unusually elected to the Board of Regents. ... And then four months beyond that, Erika (Erika Kirk) is going to enroll into ASU. For her final year of college from 2011-2012

Lo and behold, after he's put into place as the student representative. For Arizona State University, Erika Kirk, well, Erika Frantzve enrolls into Arizona State University for her final year of college.

verification.notes: Public profiles state that Erika Frantzve returned home and completed her remaining ASU coursework, while contemporaneous reporting places Bowyer's student-regent term from July 2011. This supports the chronology, though it does not establish a causal connection.

sources.relevance: Contemporaneous profile describing her return home and remaining ASU coursework.

records.text: Candace Owens cites an article reporting that Arizona Governor Jan Brewer appointed Tyler Bowyer as the newest student regent on the Arizona Board of Regents.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: It says governor appoints the new student regent. And within the article, it tells us that that's what happened. Arizona State University student Tyler (Tyler Bowyer) was appointed as the newest student regent on the Arizona Board of Regents by Governor Jan Brewer last year.

verification.notes: A contemporaneous April 2011 Daily Wildcat article states that Arizona State University student Tyler Bowyer was appointed the newest student regent by Governor Jan Brewer and would begin a two-year term in July.

sources.title: Daily Wildcat - Governor appoints new student regent
sources.relevance: Directly confirms Bowyer's appointment by Governor Jan Brewer.

records.text: Unlike the typical university committee recommendation process, Tyler Bowyer applied directly through the Arizona governor's office for the student-regent position.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: Last month, a new student regent is selected every year, rotating between the three state universities. Though regents are typically selected from recommendations made by a selection committee at the university, Bowyer applied directly through the governor's office.

verification.notes: The contemporaneous article states student regents were typically selected from university committee recommendations but Bowyer applied directly through Governor Brewer's office. Bowyer is quoted explaining he applied for multiple boards-and-commissions positions.

sources.title: Daily Wildcat - Governor appoints new student regent
sources.relevance: Directly states the typical process and Bowyer's direct application route.
